# Contributing to UniCtrl

Thanks for helping. UniCtrl is a fork of Deskflow, so changes that belong in the shared input-sharing core
may also be worth sending upstream to [deskflow/deskflow](https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow).

1. Open an issue first for anything bigger than a small fix.
2. Branch from `master`, keep the change focused and build it with the steps in [README](README.md).
3. Add or update tests for logic changes (`BUILD_TESTS` is on by default).
4. Open a pull request describing what changed and why.

See [docs/dev/contributing.md](../docs/dev/contributing.md) for code style and architecture notes.
